name: ZYNG AI
description_en:
Zyng AI now presents ZYNG OS, an enterprise visual workflow platform for commerce. Its modules cover garment combinations, virtual try-on, image standardization, visual quality checks and studio transformations.

The operational task is routing catalog assets through suitable transformations and review, not merely generating an isolated image. Quality flags and try-on previews are model outputs to evaluate; they do not establish product fit, legal clearance or guaranteed detection of every defect.
description_zh:
Zyng AI 现为 ZYNG OS 企业电商视觉流程平台，包含服装组合、虚拟试穿、图片标准化、视觉质检及工作室变换。

运营任务是将目录素材按条件转换并审核，而非只生成单图。质检标记/试穿是需评估的模型结果，不证明真实合身、权利许可或检出全部缺陷。

core_features.explanation_en: Route image types through crop, margin, transform and QC steps.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按图片类别走裁切、边距、变换及质检。

core_features.explanation_en: Use documented try-on, combinations and standardization capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用文档所述试穿、组合及标准化。

en: Standardize an authorized apparel SKU set and review deliberately flawed QC examples.
zh: 标准化授权服装 SKU 并审核已知缺陷质检样本。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm module/API and credit terms, test mixed asset types and inspect output mapping plus rejection handling.
steps.zh: 确认模块/API及额度，试混合类型并核映射和拒绝处理。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Resolution/volume consumption with separate workflow and QC credits; enterprise custom terms.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Pay-per-credit, signup hundred. HD displayed $0.063/$0.031/$0.016 per image by volume; 4K $0.125/$0.063/$0.031 and 8K $0.313/$0.156/$0.078. Workflow and QC credits distinct; module scope, thresholds and commitments need quote.

sources.title: ZYNG OS v2.0 — Enterprise Visual AI for Commerce
sources.research_notes_en: Current ZYNG OS enterprise-commerce image pipelines, try-on, standardization and QC; visual-search APIs explicitly coming soon, certifications in progress.

sources.title: ZYNG OS v2.0 — Enterprise Visual AI for Commerce
sources.research_notes_en: Homepage pay-per-credit resolution/volume bands, workflow output and separate QC credit; signup hundred credits; exact threshold and module price scope need quote.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_zh: 变换全程保护 SKU 真实
sections.en: For an illustrative apparel catalog, compare garment shape, print, color and included pieces with source photography. Configure margins and crop rules per asset type and send uncertain QC results to a human. A detected logo is not a legal infringement determination, and a passing QC result does not establish every product claim. Test both known-good and deliberately flawed assets.
sections.zh: 例如服装目录，应对照原照核形状、图案、颜色和配件，按类型设边距/裁切，疑似质检转人工。检测标志不等于侵权判定，通过也不证明全部主张，须测试已知好/坏素材。

sections.title_zh: 分开输出流程和输入质检额度
sections.en: The page says one workflow credit covers multiple transformation steps but only one final image, while one QC credit covers a scan. It offers one hundred signup credits and resolution/volume rates: HD $0.063/$0.031/$0.016 per image across displayed bands 0–500/500–20K/20K–100K; 4K and 8K cost more. Exact boundary, marginal-versus-total-volume pricing and module applicability require confirmation.
sections.zh: 页面称一流程额可多步但只输出一图，质检一额一扫描；注册100额，HD 在展示0–500/500–20K/20K–100K档每图$0.063/$0.031/$0.016，4K/8K更高。边界、分段或全量及模块适用需确认。

sections.title_en: Do not turn roadmap or ongoing compliance into certification
sections.title_zh: 不要把路线图及进行中合规写成认证
sections.en: Visual similarity/search APIs are labelled coming soon. SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR work are in progress, not completed certifications. The site describes isolated assets and no client-data training without an explicit enterprise agreement; confirm contractual scope. Anonymous case studies and live-looking counters are vendor evidence, not independently audited throughput or error rates.
sections.zh: 相似/视觉搜索 API 标即将推出，SOC2 TypeII、ISO27001、GDPR 在进行中，不能写已认证。网站称素材隔离且无明确企业协议不训练，需合同范围。匿名案例及实时样计数均为厂商资料，不是独立吞吐/错误率审计。

sections.title_en: Prove the asset route and exception handling
sections.title_zh: 证明素材路径及异常处理
sections.en: Evaluate a small SKU set with authorized image links and verify routing, final dimensions, source mapping and rejected-asset handling. The FAQ says API specifications depend on module and volume, so do not infer a universal ready-made integration. No API, try-on, QC, image pipeline, credit charge or security control was tested; retention, output rights and self-hosted deployment remain unknown.
sections.zh: 应小 SKU 集合使用授权图片链接，核路由、尺寸、源映射及拒绝处理。FAQ 称 API 规格按模块/量议定，不能推统一现成集成。本文未测 API、试穿、质检、图片流程、扣额或安全，保留、输出及自托管未知。

research_gaps: Search APIs coming soon; compliance programs in progress, not completed certifications.
No API, generation, fidelity, throughput, QC accuracy, security, retention, output license or self-hosting tested.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
